item.title: Glossary:Repair Café
item.description: ...Repair Café Repair Café International is an organisation based in Amsterdam and run by Martine Postma, who developed the original concept for Repair Café events and sparked the community repair movement. Repair Cafés are events at which volunteers help members of the public repair their electrical, electronic, mechanical and clothing items. Since the first ever repair café in 2009, Repair Café International now represents a global grassroots movement promoting repair through community......

item.title: Summary iPhone iPad and iPod repair
item.description: ...repair This page summarises the repair of Apple iPhones, iPads and iPods. Summary Apple iPhones, iPads and iPods are frequently seen at a Restart Party, often with broken screens, dead batteries or water damage. None are easy to repair but some are harder than others. This page aims to help you quickly assess whether a given device is likely to be within your capability, whether you are a beginner with such devices, or have some level of experience.
